notes.title: MERRY XMAS PERK***!
notes.content:
Hohohooo Merrrryy Christmas! 

Santa is busy doing other things, but he sent you his trustworthy Snowman helper, and a sledge full of BEER!

notes.title: KIITOS SUOMI FINLAND 6th of December KIITOS! PERK***...!!!
notes.content:
6th of December is the Independence Day of Finland. Celebrate this greit day by playing this greit game!

[b][i]Warning: This small DLC works only during 6th of December[/i][/b], and during that day the game is automaticly in HARD mode, as it is set back in days when men were REAL MEN and life was [b]TOUGH![/b]

notes.title: Game release today, and announcement of 8 majestic free DLCs!
notes.content:
Summer is over already, but the game is here! Time to relive the summer you never had, and show off your manliness!

To celebrate THE INCREDIBLE and UNFORGETTABLE success of the games launch later today, we are extremely happy to announce that we have not 1, not 2, not 4, but [b][i]8[/i][/b] [i]totally unique and totally [b]manly[/b][/i] DLCs coming for FREE during the coming week! DLCs such as "[i]1 Gallon XXXL Beer[/i]", "[i]Epic Gentleman Moustache[/i]" and "[i]The Evil Piñata of Destruction[/i]"!
